scientific_objective: Test whether pre-query acquisition context reduces unseen-participant labeled SSVEP calibration burden beyond an otherwise identical EEG-derived-Q support path.
why_a_new_candidate_is_required: The V2 synthetic V11 one-time attempt is terminally consumed after a post-claim infrastructure error and produced no scientific result.
V2 engineering-only evidence did not establish useful A_Q viability, metadata efficacy, pairing sensitivity, or sufficient adversarial abstention.
V3 changes the scientific operator by placing acquisition context at one bounded support-trust insertion point and changes the mandatory synthetic assay intersection. It is not a V2 retry.

disclosed_design_inputs.v1_source39_outcome: development_no_go; may inform requirements but is never independent V3 evidence
disclosed_design_inputs.v2_development_rows: engineering_only; 5888 rows and 19 contrasts; may inform requirements but is never V3 promotion evidence
local_nonreserved_diagnostics: root seed 20260908 was used only for small in-memory operator diagnostics
increasing lambda alone did not produce a credible metadata effect and approached or exceeded the null harm margin
removing the second attenuation while retaining metadata-weighted prototypes did not rescue metadata efficacy
a conservative prequential rule often abstained on adversarial families but requires an anti-triviality use-rate gate
disclosed_design_inputs.literature_boundary: Few/one-shot SSVEP and transfer learning already exist; V3 novelty is conditional evidence that external acquisition context adds value beyond EEG-derived Q under exact fallback and negative-transfer controls.

v3_method_change.A_Q: bounded score-prototype support residual with no acquisition-context input
v3_method_change.A_QM: the identical A_Q residual with acquisition compatibility applied exactly once to the final support-residual coefficient
v3_method_change.k0: bitwise exact A0 for A_Q and A_QM
v3_method_change.claim_boundary: empirical population-level negative-transfer control; no k=1 individual no-harm guarantee

a completed nonreserved development result and immutable selected-method freeze with one exact operator parameter pair
fresh-process historical-pulse canary using a canary-only capability
complete focused and repository-wide tests on a clean commit
an exact future-beacon attempt manifest selected only after method/code/test/canary freeze
a new signed execution authorization binding that exact attempt manifest before the target timestamp
